_about: THE NAMED BASELINE ARTIFACT (review A-8): the single machine-readable source the T1 bundle guards read. A number duplicated across plan prose can drift; this file cannot. It lives in the PLAN DIR (not scripts/, not the shipped tree) and is the evidence re-derivation tool for the lane's own baseline. B3: the route chunk is located by a ROUTE-KEYED locator (the lane-controlled marker constant) with a legacy content-marker fallback used ONLY to reproduce this lane-base baseline, and the whole route section is absent-tolerant.
measured_at_commit_means: THE REV THE MEASUREMENT WAS TAKEN AT. Every number in this file was measured with the frontend/ tree at this rev.
reproduces_at_tip_note: The numbers REPRODUCE at the current branch tip and at any later rev of this branch, because every commit after 7961bcb21 is DOCS-ONLY and the frontend/ tree is byte-identical. VERIFY with: git diff 7961bcb21..HEAD -- frontend/   (must be EMPTY). VERIFIED 2026-11-03: 0 bytes, 0 files changed; the same command over daemon/ agents/ scripts/ test/ is likewise empty (0 files changed). To re-measure at any rev, run the reproduce.command below on that rev's tree.
lane_base_equivalence: The lane's commits (c32029d1c, 3a6bf7ba5, c26cec612, dc55da10f, 7961bcb21, 0115f4818, a85abd16e, 418ff5687 and later) are docs-only — plan documents under .agents/shared/planning/ — so HEAD's frontend/ tree == the lane base's frontend/ tree at EVERY rev of this branch. A build at HEAD IS a lane-base measurement.

build.prerequisite: cd frontend && npm ci   (node_modules was absent in the fresh worktree)
build.toolchain: node v22.23.2 / npm 10.9.8; local devDependency only (never a bare tsc/npx tsc outside frontend/)
build.builder_budget_semantics: node_modules/@angular/build/src/utils/bundle-calculator.js:155-167 — InitialCalculator sums the chunks flagged `initial` (entry points + transitive STATIC imports). index.html is an ASSET, not a chunk, so it is NOT in the budget total. Lazy chunks are counted by NO budget type.

reproduce.output_locator_note: The route chunk resolves via the LEGACY content marker at lane base, because the lane-controlled marker constant (Phase 2's task 2.13) does not exist yet. From Phase 2 onward the tool resolves it by the ROUTE KEY (`route_chunk_locator: 'route-key'`). Both paths are absent-tolerant: if neither resolves, the route fields are null and `route_chunk_resolved_to_exactly_one` is false — the tool never throws and never mis-resolves (B3).

B1_initial_total_delta.threshold: |delta| <= 2048 bytes vs the frozen lane-base baseline
B1_initial_total_delta.note: A LAZY chart.js leak does NOT move this number (lazy chunks are counted by no budget) — hence B2/B3/B4 below.

B2_no_chartjs_marker_in_any_initial_chun.method: string scan of every file in the 36-file initial set for the marker `chart.js`

B3_import_shape_and_site.method: grep the resolved import sites for `from 'chart.js'` / `import('chart.js')`
B3_import_shape_and_site.threshold: 0 static `from 'chart.js'` sites anywhere; every `chart.js` import is the DYNAMIC `await import('chart.js')` form; the wrapper's own home is under src/app/pages/metrics/**
B3_import_shape_and_site.note: The DYNAMIC form is what keeps the vendor out of the route fetch set — see C-1.

B4_new_chart_chunk_size.threshold: SUPERSEDED BASIS (leader ruling IMPL-24, 2026-11-04 — a leader-AUTHORIZED threshold change with a documented rationale, NOT a silent weakening; the code council and the tester re-verify it in the open): (B4a) the new chart chunk's real min+gz bytes <= 82000 (was 65536) — the 65536 figure was G9's ESTIMATE of chart.js alone; the MEASURED barrel-mandatory composition is 71054 B gz; the new pin is measured + ~15% margin for wrapper/plugin/theme growth. (B4b) the /metrics route fetch set's LAZY-ONLY portion <= 185000 bytes on the POST-RELOCATION basis (was: growth <= 65536 vs the 72708 pre-relocation baseline) — the measured post-relocation lazy-only set is 165185 B; the growth is the RELOCATED RESOURCES MODULE (the lane's own D-3 deliverable, NOT vendor leakage); the vendor bytes appear only via dynamic import and are NOT in the fetch set.
B4_new_chart_chunk_size.note: The route FETCH SET (route chunk + its DIRECT static deps) is the threshold that actually catches a static-shape leak; the route chunk alone does not (a static import lands in a LAZY-ONLY sibling chunk — proven on the real dist). The vendor-static-edge invariant below is the LOAD-BEARING catch: the vendor chunk must appear in ZERO static-import edges anywhere in the dist (asserted by the tool; fails loud, exit 4).
B4_new_chart_chunk_size.route_chunk_locator: route-key (the marker constant from Phase 2's task 2.13), with the legacy content-marker fallback for the lane-base reproduction; absent-tolerant (null + resolved_to_exactly_one=false when unresolvable)
B4_new_chart_chunk_size.pre_retirement_resources_chunk_note: The /resources route chunk (38,914 B) is a PRE-RETIREMENT baseline only — Phase 7 retires the route, so it does not survive the lane and is NOT a Phase-9 gate (B3).
B4_new_chart_chunk_size.supersession: ESTIMATE -> MEASURED (the E-1 discipline applied in reverse, leader-authorized): G9 estimated chart.js at ~65 kB; the real D-1-mandated dynamic-barrel import (`await import('chart.js')`) materializes the WHOLE namespace object, so tree-shaking is STRUCTURALLY IMPOSSIBLE under the mandated form — all controllers ship in the chunk (Bar/Doughnut/Pie/Radar/Bubble/Scatter all present despite the explicit Chart.register(...) of only the used set; verified on the dist in Phase 4 and re-verified at Phase 9). The measured chunk is 206857 B min / 71054 B gz. Separately, Phase 5/7 RELOCATED the resources module INTO the metrics route (the route chunk grew 27672 -> 120154 B; the lazy-only fetch set 72708 -> 165185 B) — the lane's own D-3 deliverable, not leakage. The old 65536 thresholds modeled a pure charting add-on and neither the barrel impossibility nor the relocation; the new pins are the measured reality + margin (B4a ~15%; B4b 165185 -> 185000).
B4_new_chart_chunk_size.D1_enforcement_statement: D-1 IS UNCHANGED AND GREEN: D-1's binding contract is first paint = the app shell (the builder's initial set); B1 (Δ −1,301 B vs the ±2,048 bound) + B2 (0 `chart.js` markers in the initial set) + B3 (0 static import sites, statement-anchored, mutation-proven) remain THE D-1 enforcement — B4 was always second-order.
B4_new_chart_chunk_size.provenance: IMPLEMENTATION-TIME RULING (2026-11-03, lane B4 — the leader's ruling on evidence; the threshold is UNCHANGED). B4 part (2) measures the growth of the LAZY-ONLY portion of the /metrics route fetch set — the route chunk + its direct static deps, RESTRICTED to the members that are NOT in the initial set (index.html's refs + the transitive static-import closure). The total is still reported for transparency but is NOT the gate. DERIVATION PATH: a REAL BUILD of the lane-base frontend tree (a throwaway detached worktree at the artifact's measured_at_commit 7961bcb21, node_modules symlinked from the lane worktree; the worktree was removed + pruned afterwards and the shared checkout was never touched) measured with the EXTENDED bundle-baseline.measure.js — `metrics_route_fetch_set_lazy_only_bytes` = 72708 and `metrics_route_fetch_set_shared_with_initial_bytes` = 423630 (72708 + 423630 = 496338 = the frozen total). The build reproduced the artifact's lane-base figures EXACTLY (initial_total_bytes 5909018, route chunk 27672 B, route fetch set 496338 B, pre-retirement /resources chunk 38914 B). The plan's own G4b text (lane-base route chunk 27,672 B + exactly two lazy-only deps 43,688 B + 1,348 B) predicts the same 72,708 B — the real build and the plan's derivation AGREE. The tool's new fields are ADDITIVE (no existing field's semantics changed), stay route-keyed and absent-tolerant, and are null exactly when the route chunk is unresolvable. SUPERSEDED-BASIS RIDER (2026-11-04, IMPL-24): the 72708 lazy-only figure remains the PRE-relocation provenance record (the _PRE_RELOCATION_SUPERSEDED twin field retains it); the OPERATIVE gate is the post-relocation basis in threshold_B4b_route_fetch_set_lazy_only_bytes.

B4_vendor_static_edge_invariant.statement: chart.js vendor bytes in ANY static (non-dynamic) fetch set == 0
B4_vendor_static_edge_invariant.method: the vendor chunk is identified from the ROUTE-KEYED route chunk's DYNAMIC-import targets (import("chunk-….js")) — exactly one on the Phase-9 dist (chunk-TXUCW6LI.js); if a future build carries several dynamic targets, the assertion covers ALL of them; then the tool scans EVERY .js chunk in the dist for static-import edges (from "…" / import "…") targeting the vendor id(s), and also asserts the vendor is not in the initial set. FAILS LOUD: stderr RED line + exit 4 (the JSON still prints).
B4_vendor_static_edge_invariant.why_this_is_load_bearing: the re-baselined byte thresholds (B4a/B4b) are sized to the measured reality; the INVARIANT is the structural catch that survives any future growth — a planted static edge reddens the tool regardless of the byte numbers.

anyComponentStyle_baseline._about: C-3: the census is 9, NOT 8. blueprint.component.scss (18.32 kB — the LARGEST offender) was omitted. Captured MECHANICALLY from the Phase-1 production build log; the guard is a SET DIFFERENCE against this set, never a count ceiling (a ceiling can be loosened and silently lose detection).
anyComponentStyle_baseline.also_pre_existing: bundle initial exceeded maximum budget. Budget 1.00 MB was not met by 4.91 MB with a total of 5.91 MB.
anyComponentStyle_baseline.guard: SET DIFFERENCE: the Phase-9 warning set must equal this baseline set exactly (0 added, 0 removed). A count ceiling is FORBIDDEN.
